items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: that's why a buddy got such a big, you know, a big name like he did. Bubba Lewis had always been Bubba.

ctx.x: Did you mainly play for white people, or did you play?

We played more white jobs than we did colored jobs. Really? Yeah. I'm surprised to hear that. Yeah, yeah. We had lots of jobs, like I told you. All around Campwood, Louisiana. All true that, you know, that I see that we played different places over there, and, uh, that's why a buddy got such a big, you know, a big name like he did. Bubba Lewis had always been Bubba. He used to play for the male. The male used to give dances over there all the time. Uh-huh.
